whenToUse: You list items of the same shape, such as files, contacts, or settings.
Each item has a short piece of extra information.
Lists that open details when pressed.
whenNotToUse: Several values are compared by column (use a data table).
Images are the focus (use cards or a gallery).
Each item has several controls (put separate buttons in the row).
accessibility: It's a ul list, so the number of items is read along with it.
The whole row is one button, and its name is read starting with the title.
Icons and arrows are decorative, so they're aria-hidden.
Long titles are truncated, but the full text stays in the DOM.
